# Shortcuts naming follows different local roles for elements, templates and browser tests

This component defines the kebab-case tag shortcuts-container with class ShortcutsContainer, uses the template ID shortcutsContainerTemplate, and registers browser_shortcutsContainer.js. Its implementation filename matches the tag, while the template include filename and Fluent resource follow their own existing family. For new files in this exact component, follow the corresponding local role rather than imposing one dash-or-camel rule on every name. This is an observed naming pattern and scoped recommendation; syntax formatting and lint are separate, and discussion remains pending.

Scope: Customizable shortcuts naming.
